notes: The %indl(yy) macro from CPUEin_2025.sas: reads a year of Danish sandeel-fishery effort logbook data and derives fishing-trip timing fields (start/end SAS datetimes via DHMS, julian fishing day, fishing week, trip duration in days) plus yield/CPUE unit conversion. Upstream reads via INFILE from a per-year CSV on an institutional OneDrive path; this bundle keeps the macro body and every transformation line-for-line identical and substitutes DATALINES for the INFILE (the shipped runner uploads only script.sas, no input/ files), with 9 representative logbook rows spanning Mar-Nov 2025. Added a PROC PRINT of the derived fields (not upstream, but exercises their transformation logic end to end) to surface real output.
